verses.en: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.sm: O pule eseese i le malo ma le aiga O le tagata ua aoaiina soo, a e faamaaa lona ua, e faafuasei ona nutimomoia o ia, a e leai se fofo.

verses.en: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
verses.sm: A pule E amiotonu, ua olioli ai le nuu; a e a pule E amio leaga, ua mapuitiga le nuu.

verses.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
verses.sm: O le tagata ua manao i le poto, na te faatupuina le fiafia o lona tamá; a o lē aumea ma fafine talitane, na te faaumatia oloa.

verses.en: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
verses.sm: E faatumauina le nuu e le tupu i le faamasinoga; a o le tagata ua tali mea alofa, na te lepetia ai le nuu.

verses.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
verses.sm: O le tagata ua faaoleole i le la te tuaoi; na te folasia le upega i le mea e ui ai o ia.

verses.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
verses.sm: O i ai le mailei i le soliga o le tulafono e le tagata amio leaga; a o le tagata amiotonu, ua pese ma olioli o ia.

verses.en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
verses.sm: Ua manatu le tagata amiotonu i le finauga a le ua mativa; a o le amio leaga, ua le mafaufau o ia ina ia iloa.

verses.en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
verses.sm: O tagata faatauemu, latou te faamuina le aai; a o e popoto, latou te faaliliueseina le ita.

verses.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
verses.sm: O le tagata poto ua finau ma le tagata valea, pe ita, pe ‘ata‘ata, e leai se filemu.

verses.en: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
verses.sm: O tagata totolima, ua ‘ino‘ino i latou i le ua sa‘o lana amio; a o e amiotonu, latou te saili ia ola o ia.

verses.en: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
verses.sm: O le vale, e sasaa uma mai e ia lona loto; a o le tagata poto, e taofiofi e ia lona loto i tua.

verses.en: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
verses.sm: O le faipule e uai atu ona taliga i upu pepelo, e amio leaga ana auauna uma lava.

verses.en: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.
verses.sm: O le ua mativa, ma le tagata faasaua, la te fetaiai; o le ALI na te faatau faamalamalamaina o laua mata.

verses.en: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
verses.sm: O le tupu, o le na te faamasinoina ma le faamaoni e matitiva, e faatumauina lona nofoalii e faavavau.

verses.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
verses.sm: O le sasa ma le aoaiga e tupu ai le poto; a o le tama ua tuulafoaiina, e tupu ai le má o lona tina.

verses.en: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
verses.sm: A faatoateleina E amio leaga, ua faateleina le soli966 tulafono; a o e amiotonu, latou te iloa atu lo latou malaia.

verses.en: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
verses.sm: la e aoai i lou atalii, ona e maua ai lea se filemu; e tupu ai le fiafia i lou loto.

verses.en: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verses.sm: A leai se faaaliga, e faasalalauina le nuu; a o le ua tausiusi i le tulafono, amuia o ia.

verses.en: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
verses.sm: E le mafai ona aoaiina o le auauna, i upu; aua ua lagona e ia, a e le tali atu i ai.

verses.en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.sm: Ua e iloa ea le tagata ua faataalise i ana upu? e fai le faamoemoe o tagata i le vale, a e le ia te ia.

verses.en: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
verses.sm: O le ua faapelepele i lana auauna e afua mai ina itiiti, mulimuli ane e fai o ia ma atalii.

verses.en: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
verses.sm: O le tagata itagofie na te faatupuina le misa; ma le tagata lotoa na te faateleina soliga o le tulafono.

verses.en: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
verses.sm: O le faamaualuga o le tagata e faamaulaloina ai o ia; a o le faamaulalo o le loto e maua ai le viiga.

verses.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
verses.sm: O le ua vaelua mea faatasi ma le gaoi, ua ‘ʻinoʻino o ia ia te ia lava; e faalogo o ia i le tauto, a e le faaali atu.

verses.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
verses.sm: O le fefe i tagata e tupu ai le mailei; a o lé faatuatua i le Arn e faamamaluina o ia.

verses.en: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the LORD.
verses.sm: E toatele o e saili i le faipule; a o loo i le Au le faamasinoga o cavara.

verses.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
verses.sm: O e amiotonu latou te ‘ino‘ino i le tagata agapiopio; a o e amio leaga, latou te ‘ino‘ino i le ua sa‘o lona ala.
